description: A reliable multi-role SDLC workflow for Codex with review gates, human checkpoints, atomic state, and meeting records.

interface.shortDescription: Product, engineering, and testing workflow with review gates.
interface.longDescription: Run a formal software delivery workflow in any project without copying project files. The orchestrator starts with product-led clarification and explicit user confirmation, then coordinates independent product, engineering, and testing reviews, a user-visible prototype/MVP feedback point, versioned atomic state, optional human authorization checkpoints, and structured meeting records only when explicitly requested.
